results.actual: An approved ordinary HTTP URL was accepted, captured by real Chromium and advanced from PROCESSING to READY with a stored revision and SHA-256.
A credentialed URL returned 400 WEBPAGE_CREDENTIALS_BLOCKED. A Basic-auth challenge became FAILED, and the fixture recorded zero Authorization headers.
A relative same-approved-host redirect became READY at its final URL. A redirect to a reachable but unapproved hostname became FAILED and the destination request counter stayed zero.
results.diagnostic_note: The stored reason was WEBPAGE_UNREACHABLE rather than the more precise WEBPAGE_REDIRECT_BLOCKED. The security behavior passed, but failure classification is imprecise.
